method: Song-level unsupervised view: each song a composition vector over the 50 unsupervised syllable clusters (+noise) with timing stats; UMAP (n=30, min_dist=0.3, seed 42). No labels used anywhere in the feature space — unlike the by-bird song map above, which uses family labels.

battery.interpretation_note: JSD ratio ~1 means between-group composition differences are the same magnitude as within-group — no separable structure for that grouping. The nesting-aware test asks whether songs by different birds differ MORE across sites than within sites (individuals nested in sites).
